title: Civil Engineering Draftsperson
screening_questions: How many years' experience do you have as a civil drafter?
Which of the following statements best describes your right to work in Australia?
How many years' experience do you have in the construction industry?
How many years' experience do you have as an Engineering Draftsperson?
Which of the following CAD software do you have experience with?
How many years of estimating experience do you have?
Do you have customer service experience?
Do you have a current Police Check (National Police Certificate) for employment?
rationale:
Draftsperson role close to Melton; AutoCAD and Revit fit, and a truss model in Revit.
Pryda software and timber truss drafting are stated gaps; the ad asks for one year in the field.
Email application route published in the advert.
caution: Rough fit, not an interview forecast. Employer acceptance of a time-limited 485 visa and relocation are the main unknowns.
gaps: Whether Marc holds or can obtain a National Police Certificate
Whether 1 year of experience can include his overseas site roles
Fit of timber-truss drafting versus his civil road/drainage focus
